# Cornelia Bryant

[Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian)

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant has a fresh, round, pink-and-white face complemented by jolly brown eyes. Her fair hair is styled into a hard little knob held in place by a tight elastic band.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)_

## Personality

Miss Cornelia Bryant is known for having an inveterate hatred of men alongside a sharp, bitter tongue, though she also possesses a remarkably kind heart. She is an expert seamstress skilled in fine embroidery and beautiful sewing. Additionally, she is an accomplished cook, particularly renowned for her prize-winning lemon pies.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P22](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P26](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035), +1 more_

## History

Cornelia Bryant grew up as an only child for eight years, longing for siblings, before having a brother who died in his early twenties; ten years prior to her visits with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she won a prize for lemon pies at the [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). Miss Cornelia became a frequent visitor at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), entertaining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her sharp-tongued opinions and village gossip while recounting the tragic life story of their neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). She attended [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner with the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) and periodically visited to engage in lively debates on theology, gossip, and local news alongside Captain Jim and Susan Baker. When [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposed a medical operation for [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), Cornelia initially confronted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger over his intervention, though she accepted the decision once it was made. She was later amazed when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shared a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that [Dick](../character/dick.md) was actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), making [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) a free woman, prompting Cornelia to subtly suggest informing [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) of Leslie's freedom. Eventually, Cornelia shocked her friends by announcing her upcoming marriage to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), taking Gilbert's playful teasing about her sudden engagement in good stride.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P2](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P6](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P8](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P10](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P11](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P12](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0012), +87 more_

## Quotes

> "I have the Methodist minister’s word for it—if you call THAT proof. Robert Baxter told me the same thing too, but I admit THAT isn’t evidence. Robert Baxter isn’t often known to tell the truth."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P16](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0016)

> “I am sure I hope so,” said Miss Cornelia, none too hopefully. “But speaking of the devil, I am positive that Billy Booth is possessed by him now. Have you heard of Billy’s latest performance?”
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P42](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0042)

> "You always look as cool as a cucumber, Anne, dearie. Do I smell cherry pie? If I do, ask me to stay to tea. Haven’t tasted a cherry pie this summer. My cherries have all been stolen by those scamps of Gilman boys from the Glen."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P12](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0012)

> "There’s a great change come over her lately. She laughs and jokes like a girl, and from her talk I gather she’s here real often."
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P25](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0025)

> "Anne, do you mean to tell me it’s true what I’ve heard—that Dr. Blythe has told Leslie Dick can be cured, and that she is going to take him to Montreal to have him operated on?"
>
> — Cornelia Bryant — [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--cornelia-bryant.md)

Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her home to share village gossip, recount local stories, and pass the time sewing together before staying for tea. She acts as a confidante, giving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deep insight into their neighbor [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) Moore's tragic background and encouraging [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persist in befriending her. Their connection also extends to social gatherings, such as attending [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P2](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P6](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P8](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0008), +47 more_

- Friend of — close friend and confidante  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P76](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0076), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), +2 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--leslie-moore.md)

Miss Cornelia acts as a close friend and protector to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), remaining deeply invested in her life and well-being. She helps orchestrate Leslie's summer boarder arrangements by dropping [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) off to meet her, and she closely observes the impact Owen has on Leslie's life. Cornelia's fierce devotion to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) is highlighted when she angrily confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes a potential operation for Leslie's husband, [Dick](../character/dick.md), though Cornelia eventually accepts the situation.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029), +12 more_

- Friend of — best friend  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P29](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0029)</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--uncle-jim.md)

Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim share a long-standing friendship marked by regular social calls and spirited antagonism. They frequently visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) together, engaging in lively debates over theology, local gossip, and neighbors while exchanging jokes. Despite their frequent bickering and contrasting views, they remain key fixtures in the same social circle.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P0](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), +10 more_
